name: Fuchsgrub
beschreibung:
Overview

Haus Fuchsgrub is a Tyrolean farmhouse with holiday apartments at Buchberg 18 in Ebbs (A-6341), a village in the Tyrolean Unterland. It is run by the Anker family. According to the website, the farm is situated in a quiet, secluded spot on the edge of the forest, below the romantic little St Nicholas church; the centre of Ebbs is about a 15-minute walk away. Guests stay in cosy, comfortably furnished holiday apartments and are welcomed in a family atmosphere. You can hike directly from the house into the Kaisertal. The establishment sees itself as a starting point for bikers, hikers, mountaineers and nature lovers. A covered carport and a parking space are available at the house.

History/Background

The official sources do not provide any information about the founding history of the house. What is documented is that it is a traditional Tyrolean farmhouse that is now run as holiday accommodation by the Anker family. The offering comprises two holiday apartments in Ebbs as well as a holiday bungalow in St. Johann in Tirol. The apartments have family-friendly layouts: Apartment 1 measures around 35 square metres on the first floor and is intended for 2 to 3 people, with a living room (radio, satellite TV), a kitchen with a modern kitchen unit, a bedroom with shower/WC and a balcony. Apartment 2 covers around 70 square metres on the second floor for 2 to 5 people, with a living room (radio, satellite TV, dining area), a fully equipped kitchen, two bedrooms, shower/WC and a balcony. Wi-Fi is free in both apartments. Both apartments have a separate entrance directly from the covered carport. A bread roll delivery service and, on request, breakfast are also offered.

Getting there

According to the establishment, travellers from Germany can arrive via the Inntal motorway, Oberaudorf exit, without a vignette; alternatively via the A8, Frasdorf exit, then via Aschau, Sachrang and Niederndorferberg. By train, the Oberaudorf or Kufstein stations are suitable: from Oberaudorf it is about 8 km by taxi to Ebbs, from Kufstein about 10 km by post bus or taxi. Innsbruck and Salzburg airports are each around 90 km away, Munich about 110 km.

Tips

Close by are the Haflinger stud farm Fohlenhof Ebbs and the Raritätenzoo Ebbs (rare breeds zoo). According to the provider, a cycling and hiking paradise stretches out from the house, from easy walks and gentle mountain hikes to extreme climbing; the destinations can be reached on foot. A guide price applies for the accommodation from € 25.00 per day including bed linen and towels, plus final cleaning; in addition there is a local tourist tax of € 3.50 per person per day. Prices depend on the number of people, the season and the length of stay. Breakfast is possible for short stays.

Best time to travel

One source does not name any specific best time to travel. Since the house is described as a starting point for hikers, mountaineers, bikers and winter sports enthusiasts in the Kufstein-Kaisergebirge region, both the warmer months are suitable for hikes in the Kaisertal and the winter for activities in the surrounding mountains.
